notes:
Lead source: inbound – trial signup via pricing page (used free credits).

Background:
- Small e-comm SaaS (website personalization + post-purchase support).
- Started PoC to replace rule-based FAQ bot with LLM-driven support + compressed summaries for order hits.
- Primary constraint: gross margin per customer is tight — token spend must be minimized.

Key requirements / asks from initial calls:
- Cost optimization playbook: batching, prefix caching, prompt compression techniques.
- Token usage audit: want Redwood to run quick audit on their sample logs (1 week).
- Throughput: low concurrency per customer but many small requests (avg request=145 tokens).
- Latency: 200-400ms p50 for short-turn support messages is desirable but they are flexible if cost tradeoffs are clear.
- Security: SOC2 required; SSO for admin UI; audit logs + basic retention controls.

Model/preferences/ops:
- Interested in smaller open weights + quantized variants for cost (mentions "llama2-13b, quantized where possible").
- Wants automatic fallback to cheaper model for non-sensitive prompts.
- Interested_products: hosted_api only (self-serve).

Recent timeline / activity (bulleted):
- 2026-02-20: inbound sign-up, used free credits to run simple chat tests.
- 2026-02-24: intro call (Maya + Diego) — captured high-level requirements, budget band.
- 2026-03-02: customer shared token export sample (small set, 7 days) via Drive link.
- 2026-03-05: SE (Diego) did quick scan — spotted many repeated prefixes and uncompressed prompt metadata.
- 2026-03-09: Hands-on workshop/demo: live batching + prefix caching demo using hosted endpoints; preliminary savings ~18% on sample.
- 2026-03-10: Follow-up email sent with next-steps and request for broader token export and app flow diagrams.

Quotes / customer color:
- "We need to cut token spend by ~40% to keep unit economics intact — otherwise margins vanish on small accounts."
- "Prefer to stay on hosted if we can get predictable cost and minimal infra ops."

POC scope suggested by SE:
- Phase 0: token usage audit (1 week) — run Redwood audit on provided logs, identify top 10 prompt hotspots and quick wins.
- Phase 1: apply prompt compression + canonicalization rules + server-side prefix caching on hosted_api routes. Measure delta.
- Phase 2: enable batching for background summarization + async routes; evaluate impact on latency vs cost.

Open questions / blockers:
- Need permission to access wider token logs (request sent 3/10).
- CTO needs business case and projected ROI (ask: show 30–40% savings scenario).
- Legal asked for SOC2 evidence and third-party subprocessors list (Drive link shared).

Next steps (short):
- Send custom cost-optimization playbook + sample token audit plan (ACTION: Maya).
- SE to prepare quick lab results showing batching tradeoffs for small payloads (ACTION: Diego) by 3/14.
- Schedule 60m tech deep-dive week of 3/15 to review audit output + required permissions.

Notes style: shorthand, fragments okay — keeping timeline + action owners for AE/SE follow-up.
